subject: RECORD KEY clause
notes: kb/Work PB1025. cite.py --check 12.4.5.12.3 "data-name-1 and each data-name-2 shall be contained within the first n bytes of the record" -> OK SR4. Unenforced before PB1025. A FileControlKeyRules row (COBOL0863) measures the RECORD KEY's furthest reach through RecordLayout.KeyWindowOf - its offset, or for a key a dynamic-length member precedes its fixed-run offset plus every preceding member at its maximum (13.18.43.4 GR8 b) - against FileModel.VaryMin (13.18.43.4 GR9 when integer-2 is unstated; D-FRA (iv) for an implied Format 2). A legal key after a dynamic member is located per record by CobolContiguousLayout.Position (CONFORMANCE.md section 3 D-KWV). Each data-name-2 of the SOURCE form (kb/Work PB1099, provided from 2002; review R1-3) is measured as its own operand - FileControlKeyRules.SourceOperands yields one per data-name-2 - and reported once, naming the operand beyond the minimum and not its siblings within it (FileControlKeyRuleSpecTests.SourcePhraseOperand_BeyondTheMinimumRecordSize_IsSR4_ForThatOperandOnly).
